content:
; Proofs / certificates for the proof obligations in obligations.txt
; ====================================================================
;
; Checker: Z3 5.1.0. Z3 verifies the obligations fully automatically —
; no manual proof steps are required. This file is the generated input
; that drives the checker:
;
;   1. Proof production is enabled via (set-option :produce-proofs true).
;   2. Each obligation (from obligations.txt) is asserted in negated form
;      and refuted: (check-sat) must answer `unsat`.
;   3. (get-proof) then emits the concrete proof term Z3 derived for each
;      obligation. Each term is a step-by-step derivation ending in the
;      fact `false` derived from the asserted hypothesis — the machine-
;      checkable certificate that no counterexample exists. The steps use
;      only sound inference rules (rewrite, monotonicity, quant-intro,
;      trans, mp, ...), applied by Z3's proof kernel.
;
; Run with:
;   /tmp/pylibs/bin/z3 -smt2 -file:proofs.txt
;
; Expected output: for each of the 5 proofs, one line `unsat` followed by
; a (proof ...) term. Any deviation means a law fails.

(set-option :produce-proofs true)

; Definitions mirroring arith.py
(define-fun add ((a Int) (b Int)) Int (+ a b))
(define-fun multiply ((a Int) (b Int)) Int (* a b))

; --------------------------------------------------------------------
; Proof 1 — Obligation 1: add is commutative
; --------------------------------------------------------------------
(push)
(assert
  (not
    (forall ((a Int) (b Int))
      (= (add a b) (add b a)))))
(check-sat)
(get-proof)
(pop)

; --------------------------------------------------------------------
; Proof 2 — Obligation 2: add is associative
; --------------------------------------------------------------------
(push)
(assert
  (not
    (forall ((a Int) (b Int) (c Int))
      (= (add (add a b) c) (add a (add b c))))))
(check-sat)
(get-proof)
(pop)

; --------------------------------------------------------------------
; Proof 3 — Obligation 3: multiply is commutative
; --------------------------------------------------------------------
(push)
(assert
  (not
    (forall ((a Int) (b Int))
      (= (multiply a b) (multiply b a)))))
(check-sat)
(get-proof)
(pop)

; --------------------------------------------------------------------
; Proof 4 — Obligation 4: multiply is associative
; --------------------------------------------------------------------
(push)
(assert
  (not
    (forall ((a Int) (b Int) (c Int))
      (= (multiply (multiply a b) c)
         (multiply a (multiply b c))))))
(check-sat)
(get-proof)
(pop)

; --------------------------------------------------------------------
; Proof 5 — Obligation 5: multiply distributes over add
; --------------------------------------------------------------------
(push)
(assert
  (not
    (forall ((a Int) (b Int) (c Int))
      (= (multiply a (add b c))
         (add (multiply a b) (multiply a c))))))
(check-sat)
(get-proof)
(pop)

(exit)
